title: Personal loan eligibility
text: For this fictional support service, personal loan applicants must be at least 21 years old and show a stable source of income. Eligibility is reviewed against identity verification, existing debts, and repayment capacity. Approval is never guaranteed.

title: Home loan eligibility
text: Home loan applications require evidence of income and property-related documentation. The review team considers existing liabilities and the proposed down payment. Property valuation may be required before approval.

title: Auto loan eligibility
text: Auto loan applicants must provide a vehicle quotation and proof of repayment capacity. Both new and used vehicles may be considered under separate lending terms. Final approval depends on verification and credit assessment.

title: Education loan eligibility
text: Education loan applications require an admission letter and estimated tuition expenses. A co-applicant may be requested depending on the case. The lending team checks supporting documents before deciding.

title: Business loan eligibility
text: Business loan applicants provide business registration information and financial statements. The team reviews operating history and cash flow. Additional security may be requested for higher loan amounts.

title: EMI calculation
text: For a fixed-rate loan, EMI is calculated as P times r times (1+r) to the power n, divided by ((1+r) to the power n minus 1). P is principal, r is the monthly interest rate, and n is the number of monthly installments. Actual repayment schedules depend on the final agreement.

title: Credit card fees
text: This fictional program may charge an annual card fee, a late payment fee, and interest on unpaid balances. Applicable amounts depend on the card agreement. Support agents should not quote a specific fee without the member's fee schedule.

title: KYC documentation
text: Identity verification requires an accepted identity document and address evidence. The team may request PAN information where applicable. Customers should submit sensitive documents only through an approved secure channel.

title: Fraud dispute resolution
text: Customers should report a suspected unauthorized transaction promptly through an official support channel. The dispute team records the complaint and may temporarily restrict account activity. A review determines the outcome and any eligible adjustment.

title: Account closure
text: An account closure request can be processed after outstanding balances and pending transactions are resolved. Customers may need to complete identity verification. Written confirmation is issued after closure is completed.

title: Interest rate slabs
text: Interest rates in this fictional lending program vary by loan type, credit assessment, and tenure. A displayed indicative rate is not a binding offer. The final rate must be confirmed in the sanction letter.

title: Prepayment penalties
text: Some loan agreements permit early repayment without a charge while others include a prepayment fee. The applicable rule depends on the product and signed agreement. Support must check the contract before confirming any penalty.

title: Minimum balance
text: Certain account types require a monthly average minimum balance. Other account types may waive this requirement. Customers should check their account-specific schedule for the exact amount and any shortfall fee.

title: Credit score factors
text: Payment history, credit utilization, and recent credit applications may influence credit scores. Missed payments can negatively affect a credit profile. No particular score change can be guaranteed.

title: Joint account rules
text: Joint accounts may have multiple authorized holders. Operating instructions determine whether one or all holders must authorize a transaction. Changes to account ownership require verification and approval.

title: NRI account eligibility
text: Non-resident Indian customers may qualify for designated account types subject to regulatory and identity requirements. Residency declarations and overseas address documents may be requested. Product availability depends on the bank's current rules.
